params.body:
## What

Inzichten > Activiteit shows its measures as one plain list and the garage table as one plain row of columns again. The two named groups from #911 (a head and a grey explanation over each, in the measure list and as an extra head row over the garage table) are gone, together with the rule and the extra room between them.

The distinction between what a garage does itself and what others do with its cars now lives in two places:

- **The order.** `Measures::ALL` is unchanged: the garage's own doing first, then colleagues and website visitors.
- **The names.** Short enough for one line in the narrow list at 1440 (at most 24 characters in every language, pinned by a test), two lines at most at 390.

| | nl | fr | en | de |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| handlings | Handelingen | Actions | Handlings | Handlungen |
| edits | Bewerkingen | Modifications | Edits | Bearbeitungen |
| views | Schermen geopend | Écrans ouverts | Screens opened | Bildschirme geöffnet |
| stocklist_opens | Stocklist geopend | Stocklist ouverte | Stocklist opened | Stocklist geöffnet |
| cars_looked | Bekeken in stocklist | Vus dans la stocklist | Viewed in stocklist | In Stocklist angesehen |
| signins | Aanmeldingen | Connexions | Sign-ins | Anmeldungen |
| cars_platform | Bekeken door collega's | Vus par des confrères | Viewed by colleagues | Von Kollegen angesehen |
| cars_embed | Bekeken in widget | Vus dans le widget | Viewed in widget | Im Widget angesehen |
| cars_site | Bekeken op website | Vus sur le site | Viewed on website | Auf Website angesehen |
| embed_opens | Widget geopend | Widget ouvert | Widget opened | Widget geöffnet |

The full meaning of a name is the sentence under the chart once the measure is chosen (no native tooltips on this screen). The sentences of the four car-view measures now say "a car was viewed", because the name no longer carries the word. The chart's title line lost the group word and is the measure, the period and the peak.

## The measure list

- "Before" and "change" are filled only for a measure that has a period to compare with. Without one the two cells are empty, not a dash. When no measure in the list has a comparison (the whole history) the two columns are not rendered.
- Numbers right-aligned with tabular figures, the first day stays as a quiet last column.
- The list column of the wide layout went from 380 to 420 px so all ten names fit on one line; on a phone the cells stand closer together so the table fits its card (it overflowed it by 50 px).

## The garage table

After #911 the table was cut off at the right edge of its card and did not scroll. Two causes:

- The rule that gives the table the full width of the grid (`.act > [data-section="dealers"]`) named the table, which had moved one level down into the scroll frame. The frame landed in one grid cell.
- The frame is a grid item, and a grid item is as wide as its content unless it has `min-width: 0`. It grew with the table instead of scrolling.

Now the card is the section and the scroll frame: it spans the grid, does not grow with the table, and scrolls sideways inside itself. The page body never scrolls sideways. Head labels and garage names are on one line (the fixed `min-width: 1080px` is gone, the content sets the width), the head row has its normal height, a garage name gets 180 to 260 px with an ellipsis beyond that, and from 640 px up the name column stays in place while the numbers scroll.

Checked in a browser at 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 with eighteen garages and all ten measures: no sideways page scroll at any width, head row 29 px, every row one line, the frame scrolls and the name stays (from 768).

## Catalogue

`Measures::GROUPS`, `Measures::OWN`, `Measures::REACH` and `Measures::group()` are removed: nothing reads them any more. The `groups` key left the cached screen array, so the cache key goes to `activity.screen.7`. Nothing that is counted or stored changes.

## Rules

R P3-16.24 is reworded: one plain list, the distinction in order and names, the comparison columns, the table scrolling in its own card. It keeps its number, since most of it (the sentence that names the actor, what a handling holds) still stands. R P3-16.25 and R P3-16.22 carry the new names.

## Tests

`WhatAGarageDoesIsNotWhatOthersDoWithItsCarsTest` is rewritten for the screen part: the order of the catalogue and no groups in it, one head row and no `colspan` in the garage table, the scroll frame in the markup and in the stylesheet, one body in the measure list, the comparison cells (filled, empty, and columns absent over the whole history), the title line of the chart, and short unique names plus a sentence in four languages with the group texts gone. The three tests on the garage's own looking (R P3-16.25) are untouched.
params.title: Activity: one plain list of measures, and a garage table that scrolls in its card
